coordinates.depth: Z; left/right are named sockets, never inferred from screen direction
coordinates.transforms: Local TRS and inverse bind matrices from GLBs; world positions include catalog placement, exclude shared floor offset and garage suspension. Bind data is captured before mixer evaluation.

driverOrder: AnimationMixer evaluates selected rider clip at absolute time

integrationConstraints: Game physics pose remains authoritative; clips must not move visible mass independently of the shared physical mass/pose mapping.
Current 19 deform bones lack finger and forearm twist chains; facial/garment corrective approval is not implied.
Socket distances do not prove glove/sole surface fit or collision clearance.
Prescribed garage kinematics do not validate weight transfer, impact response or game integration.
